name: 壁垒护手
prompt: Production 3D-model reference sheet of ONE detachable fantasy sword CROSSGUARD, derived from the bronze guard in the reference sword. Only crossguard, absolutely no blade, no handle, no pommel, no blue crystal. Three equal vertical panels arranged left to right: FRONT orthographic, LEFT SIDE orthographic, BACK orthographic. Same object, identical scale, consistent shape and exactly matched features across views. Wide landscape canvas 1536x1024, each view centered in its equal third, ample white gutters, clean pure white background, no shadows, no text, no labels or lines. Material all antique warm bronze metal with satin brushed faces and subtle brighter polished bevels, no gems, no colored panels. The attachment at center is a downward-pointing V-shaped saddle that cradles a wide flat sword blade, with a central blade insertion slot seen from side, and a short socket underneath to meet a black handle. Central mounting collar must stay compact, its bottom level fixed; all arms extend sideways or up toward blade, never downward into the hands. Realistic crisp hard-surface modeling, clear coherent depth, smooth machined planes rather than ornamental noise. Symmetric about center left-right. BASTION VARIANT: substantial broad shield-like bronze wings, span 24 cm, blade-facing layered chevron ridges and reinforced thick rounded ends. Front outline a strong shallow M with V central saddle, wide protective plates and clean stepped bevels. Heavy defensive architecture, four large simple facets per wing, 4cm central thickness, 7cm overall height. No perforations. Based on the reference V-wing collar, clearly chunkier and more armored.
